names.zh: 沉陷圆形广场建筑组合

summary.zh: 平台丘与沉陷圆形广场配对；Fieldiana：该模式至少可追溯到公元前第三千纪；班杜里亚丘 1 亦见圆形沉陷广场。
summary.en: Mound–sunken circular plaza pairing; Fieldiana: present by third millennium BCE; Bandurria Mound 1 likewise has circular sunken plaza.
